text: 工商银行公告，本行于2026年11月11日收到上交所出具的《关于中国工商银行股份有限公司向特定对象发行股票的交易所审核意见》，认为本行向特定对象发行股票申请符合发行条件、上市条件和信息披露要求。本次向特定对象发行A股股票事项尚需经中国证监会同意注册后方可实施，最终能否获得中国证监会同意注册的决定及其时间尚存在不确定性。
text_en: ICBC announced that on November 11, 2026, it received the Shanghai Stock Exchange's "Exchange Review Opinion on Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited's Targeted Stock Issuance," which held that the bank's application for a targeted stock issuance meets the issuance conditions, listing conditions and information disclosure requirements. This targeted A-share issuance still requires a registration decision from the CSRC before implementation, and whether and when final registration approval will be obtained remains uncertain.
